data.title: Insurer requests list of stolen items and receipts for burglary claim
data.summary: Musterländische Versicherung VVaG acknowledges your burglary claim (Schadennummer HR-26-0714 882, contract MV 55 120 447) for the break-in on 11 July 2026 and asks you to send a list of the stolen items with purchase year and price, along with the purchase receipts, by the deadline shown (10 working days from the letter's date).
data.explanation: Your home contents insurer needs documentation to process your burglary claim. Write up a list of the stolen items (Stehlgutliste) including the year each was bought and its price, gather the purchase receipts, and send both to the insurer by the deadline shown. Also give a copy of the same list to the police so the items can be entered into their search database. If you're missing some receipts, send what you have and explain the gaps, or contact the insurer directly — delays could slow down your claim payout. Keep copies of everything you submit.
